scope: Read all five reports, inspect all 76 unique source URLs, verify cited methods against author abstracts and detailed claims against full primary texts. Retrieval alone does not establish claim support.

findings.issue: DWS attribution overstates its explicit conclusion by adding latency/quality limits. Attribute only its stated limitations: extended temporal horizons and high spatial resolutions. Keep any broader speed/quality discussion clearly marked as survey synthesis supported by appropriate sources.
findings.evidence: Section 6 Conclusion and Limitation states that DWS is limited in modeling videos with extended temporal horizons or high spatial resolutions. Its related-work discussion claims reduced inference latency, which is not an explicit DWS latency limitation.
